name: 11735 · Farmingdale, NY
findings: ZIP 11735 (Farmingdale) has 176 nonprofit organizations. 85 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 73 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11735 (Farmingdale) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 11735 (Farmingdale) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 73 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
